source.name: Oregon Department of Fish and Wildlife — 2025 big game harvest summaries (mandatory harvest reporting)

notes: ODFW 2025-season controlled-hunt harvest, reported PER HUNT AND PER WMU, from ODFW's '2025 Estimated ... Harvest by Zone, Wildlife Management Unit and Hunt, based on Mandatory Harvest Survey Reports' PDFs: https://myodfw.com/sites/default/files/2026-04/Buck_Deer_Any_Legal_Weapon_Harvest_Summary.pdf ; https://myodfw.com/sites/default/files/2026-04/Buck_Deer_Archery_Harvest_Summary.pdf ; https://myodfw.com/sites/default/files/2026-04/Buck_Deer_Muzzleloader_Harvest_Summary.pdf ; https://myodfw.com/sites/default/files/2026-04/Antlerless_Deer_Harvest_Summary.pdf ; https://myodfw.com/sites/default/files/2026-04/Elk_Any_Legal_Weapon_Harvest_Summary.pdf ; https://myodfw.com/sites/default/files/2026-04/Elk_Archery_Harvest_Summary.pdf ; https://myodfw.com/sites/default/files/2026-04/Elk_Muzzleloader_Harvest_Summary.pdf ; https://myodfw.com/sites/default/files/2026-04/Pronghorn_Harvest_Summary.pdf. A hunt that spans several WMUs appears once per WMU (hunters are counted in the WMU they reported hunting most), so one huntCode can have several rows. unit = WMU number (ODFW layer UNIT_NUM) matched from ODFW's unit name. hunters = 'Total Hunters'; harvest = 'Harvest Total'; successPct = ODFW's printed 'Success %' (survey-based estimate; it does not always equal harvest / hunters exactly). Only the 'Controlled' sections are used. Left out: general-season rows, rows with 0 hunters, 3 short rows with blank cells that could not be read safely (119A McKenzie portion, 644A2, 644A3), and a row ODFW printed above 100% (210C2 Scappoose portion, 133%). weapon comes from the report (archery and muzzleloader files; the any-legal-weapon and antlerless files -> rifle unless the hunt name says Bow/Muzzleloader). huntCode is the 2025 hunt number. Western Oregon deer, elk and pronghorn hunt numbers mostly carry over to 2026, but every 2025 EASTERN OREGON DEER hunt (WMU-based, e.g. 131-178) was replaced in 2026 by hunt-area hunts (DG102 etc.), so those 2025 rows only match 2026 draw rows by WMU, not by hunt code. Bighorn sheep and Rocky Mountain goat: ODFW '2025 Oregon Reported ... Harvest' tables (https://myodfw.com/sites/default/files/2026-02/Bighorn_Sheep_Harvest_Summary_2025.pdf ; https://myodfw.com/sites/default/files/2026-02/Rocky_Mountain_Goat_Harvest_Summary_2025.pdf) give tags, harvest and percent success per hunt (success = harvest / tags as ODFW prints it; hunters afield is not published, so hunters = null). Left out: rows ODFW printed above 100% (546A 133%, 568A1 200%, 946A 200%; ODFW notes auction/raffle and tribal tags were filled in some areas) and a second '559A1 S Snake Rvr' line (duplicate hunt number in ODFW's table). Sheep/goat unit = WMU from the hunt number. daysPerHarvest is not set (ODFW publishes days hunted, not days per harvest).
